title: Chimichanga
description: A crispy, golden-fried Mexican tortilla filled with a savory mixture of seasoned meat, beans, cheese, and flavorful vegetables.

title: Salsa Roja
description: A vibrant Mexican red salsa made with ripe tomatoes, chilies, onion, garlic, and fresh herbs for a rich and spicy flavor.

title: Salsa Verde
description: A fresh and tangy green salsa made with tomatillos, chilies, onion, garlic, and cilantro.

title: Guacamole
description: Creamy avocado dip blended with lime, onion, tomato, cilantro, and a touch of chili for a classic Mexican flavor.

title: Mexican Sour Cream
description: A smooth, creamy, and mildly tangy homemade sour cream that pairs perfectly with tacos, nachos, burritos, and other Mexican dishes.

title: Flour Tortillas (Soft & Chewy)
description: Soft and chewy homemade flour tortillas with a tender texture, perfect for tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and wraps.

title: Corn Tortillas (Gluten-Free)
description: Authentic gluten-free corn tortillas made with masa harina, offering a soft, pliable texture and traditional corn flavor.

title: Homemade Tortilla Chips (Totopos)
description: Crispy golden tortilla chips made from corn tortillas, perfect for dipping into salsa, guacamole, or serving with Mexican appetizers.

title: Nachos with Fresh Tomato Salsa
description: Crunchy tortilla chips layered with melted cheese and bright fresh tomato salsa for a simple and flavorful Mexican appetizer.

title: Classic Loaded Nachos
description: Crispy tortilla chips loaded with seasoned beef, melted cheese, beans, and fresh toppings for a satisfying restaurant-style appetizer.

title: Fully Loaded Nachos
description: An indulgent plate of crispy nachos topped with seasoned meat, melted cheese, beans, fresh vegetables, and flavorful sauces.

title: Nachos with Corn Salsa
description: Crispy tortilla chips topped with melted cheese and fresh corn salsa, combining creamy, crunchy, sweet, and savory flavors.

title: Mexican Chopped Salad
description: A colorful Mexican-inspired salad featuring crisp vegetables, black beans, corn, Cotija cheese, and a refreshing lime dressing.

title: Mexican Chicken Salad
description: A fresh and hearty salad combining seasoned chicken, mixed greens, vegetables, black beans, and a creamy lime dressing.

title: Spicy Beans with Tortilla Chips
description: Creamy and spicy seasoned black beans served with crispy homemade tortilla chips and fresh Mexican-inspired toppings.

title: Chicken Tacos
description: Juicy seasoned chicken tucked into warm corn tortillas and topped with fresh salsa, crunchy cabbage, queso fresco, and zesty garnishes.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
description: Golden flour tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, vegetables, and melted cheese, then grilled until crisp and delicious.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Tender marinated chicken cooked with colorful bell peppers and onions, served sizzling with warm tortillas and classic toppings.

title: Mexican Rice (Arroz Rojo)
description: Fluffy Mexican red rice cooked with tomatoes, garlic, onion, and aromatic spices for a flavorful side dish.

title: Chicken Enchiladas (Enchiladas de Pollo)
description: Soft corn tortillas filled with tender shredded chicken, smothered in homemade red enchilada sauce, topped with cheese, and baked until bubbly.

title: Paneer Enchiladas
description: A delicious Mexican-Indian fusion dish featuring seasoned paneer wrapped in tortillas and baked with rich enchilada sauce and melted cheese.

title: Mushroom Burrito
description: A hearty flour tortilla filled with savory seasoned mushrooms, vegetables, beans, and flavorful toppings for a satisfying vegetarian burrito.

title: Entomatado de Pollo (Pollo en Salsa de Tomate)
description: Tender chicken simmered in a rich tomato sauce infused with garlic, onion, chilies, and aromatic Mexican spices.

title: Mushroom Tostadas
description: Crispy tostadas topped with savory sautéed mushrooms, creamy lime dressing, queso fresco, and fresh Mexican garnishes.
